_comment: Eval dataset for label matching. THREE buckets: image_cases (real photos, OCR cached), text_cases (instant, no AWS), negative_cases (must match NOTHING). Add real cases with: python scripts/eval/capture.py <photo> [--negative]. image_cases are exhaustive by default (set partial:true to count recall only); text and negative cases are always exhaustive so false positives are measured.

image_cases.note: migrated from manifest.json; partial=true until all visible products are confirmed labeled, then flip to false to measure false positives here
